forward_plan: Deploy readers that tolerate both v2 and v3 before requiring v3 traceability fields.
Generate v3 PMM snapshots with identity_registry and traceability_contract for new/recalculated proposals.
Keep all v2 fields unchanged while downstream consumers adopt canonical identities.
Enforce no-orphan output reconciliation only where calculation identities are supplied.
rollback_plan: Existing v2-compatible consumers continue to read legacy PMM fields because no legacy field was removed.
Ignore additive v3 fields when rolling back; no stored customer drawing mutation is required.
data_validation: PMM entity IDs are deterministic and unique.
Legacy drawing manifest and level fields are unchanged.
Calculation IDs are unique for room/system engineering identities.
Plan/Riser/Calculation/Schedule reconciliation fails closed on orphan or mismatched identities.
deprecation_window: PMM v2 remains readable until a separately approved breaking migration removes compatibility; no removal is authorized by this migration.
